lines.arcade.title: ARCADE
lines.arcade.setting.look.help: Remaster: lit, with HD rigs and glowing lines. Classic: as the cabinets first looked. C switches it in play
lines.arcade.maze.about: EAT EVERY SEED, DODGE FOUR WISPS
lines.arcade.formation.about: MOTHS FLY IN, FORM UP AND DIVE

notes.arcade.title: The cabinet's title screen: a row of three arcade cabinets, one per game.
notes.arcade.setting.group: The settings screen's heading for this game's own settings.
notes.arcade.setting.look: A setting: how the three games look.
notes.arcade.setting.look.remaster: The look with light, detailed characters and glowing lines.
notes.arcade.setting.look.classic: The look of the original 1980s cabinets.
notes.arcade.setting.look.help: The setting's help. HD rigs: the characters drawn in detail. C is the key that switches the look while playing (keep it).
notes.arcade.maze: The first game's name (a Pac-Man-like maze game), on its cabinet's marquee, written down the sides of a wide screen a letter at a time, and in its high-score table's title.
notes.arcade.maze.about: The maze game in a line: eat every glow-seed while four wisps (small ghost-like spirits) hunt you.
notes.arcade.maze.card: A card between mazes: {level} is the maze's number.
notes.arcade.maze.ready: Over the maze before play starts.
notes.arcade.maze.intermission: A short cartoon between mazes (Pac-Man's intermissions).
notes.arcade.formation: The second game's name (a Galaga-like shooter where moths fly in formation).
notes.arcade.formation.about: The formation game in a line.
notes.arcade.formation.card: A card before each wave of moths: {wave} is its number.
notes.arcade.rocks: The third game's name (an Asteroids-like game).
notes.arcade.rocks.about: The rocks game in a line: turn the ship, thrust it forward, shoot rocks that split.
notes.arcade.rocks.card: A card before each wave of rocks: {wave} is its number.
notes.arcade.player: Whose turn it is in a game of two players taking turns: PLAYER 1 or PLAYER 2.
notes.arcade.note.classic: A notice when the player switches to the classic look.
notes.arcade.note.remaster: A notice when the player switches back to the remastered look.
notes.arcade.table: A game's high-score table: {game} is its name (MAZE, FORMATION, ROCKS).
notes.arcade.hi: Under a cabinet on the title: the best score on it.
notes.arcade.players: The title's choice of one or two players (up and down change it); the arrows say it can be changed.
notes.arcade.how.pad: The title's help on a controller: the d-pad picks a cabinet, {key:confirm} plays, {key:classic} switches the look.
notes.arcade.how.keys: The title's help on a keyboard (shown in capitals): the arrow keys pick, {key:confirm} plays, {key:classic} switches the look.
notes.action.thrust: The rocks game's ship's engine (a button and a name on the controls screen).
notes.action.warp: The rocks game's hyperspace jump: the ship vanishes and appears elsewhere.
notes.action.classic: The key that switches between the remastered and the classic look.

brief: The arcade cabinet: three short games after the golden-age classics (MAZE after Pac-Man, FORMATION after Galaga, ROCKS after Asteroids), each with its high-score table, picked from a row of cabinets. Its words are short arcade capitals, as on 1980s cabinets: cards (STAGE 2, READY!), names on marquees, a line about each game. The player is unseen; address them with the familiar "you".
